EURUSD.state: Sellers hold the near-term edge after breaking the latest confirmed swing floor, but the broader market remains trapped in erratic transition.
paragraphs: Sellers currently dictate the immediate path of least resistance after driving price through the broken 1.1455 confirmed swing low down to 1.1390. This downward push aligns with the confirmed swing structure featuring lower highs and lower lows, while the neutral SAR resting at 1.14808 continues to act as near-term overhead friction. Control right now leans clearly toward the downside over the immediate run of 6 bricks. However, this seller dominance lacks clean coordination, as the market is still wrestling with intense internal noise rather than executing a smooth, orderly trend.

A sharp contrast emerges when comparing the broad historical balance across the full 104 bricks with the recent behavior of the last 29 bricks. Across the entire 104-brick history, the market maintained an almost even split with 53 bullish bricks and 51 bearish bricks alongside nearly identical average run lengths around 2.4 bricks. Yet, the recent 12-run window reveals a distinct shift where selling pressure has stretched significantly. Bearish runs recently averaged 3.5 bricks with a longest run of 6, whereas bullish counters stalled out with an average of just 1.33 bricks. This shows that sellers are temporarily capturing more room when they press.

The internal quality of this move explains why the current downside pressure cannot yet be trusted as a durable trend. Re-acceleration ticked up from 14.1 to 17.3, and balance and chop remains extraordinarily high at 94.5, proving that the latest selling runs are becoming sharper and more abrupt without removing the underlying disorder. At the same time, continuation dropped slightly from 34.3 to 33.7, while transition pressure sits firm at 75.3. These internal shifts reveal a market that is aggressively flipping back and forth rather than building clean directional persistence. The downward push is occurring inside a transitional state where disorder dominates the background.

The immediate price map places current price right at the harmonic D completion point of 1.1390, just above the lower Bollinger band boundary sitting at 1.13458 and the harmonic X point at 1.13531. The first reclaim zone sits just overhead around the broken 1.1455 swing low, the Bollinger middle band at 1.14295, and the SAR level near 1.14808. A recovery through that cluster would immediately neutralize short-term bearish control. Far above current price, the falling LR150-S8 trend anchor rests at 1.16086, maintaining a massive structural ceiling that confirms the broader trend control remains anchored well overhead.

Several factors explain why this downward move could either extend or fail abruptly from current levels. On one hand, low opposing wick pressure with an active fraction of 55.8 percent and a pressure index of 5.5 indicates that buyers are putting up very little rejection against the current selling wave. On the other hand, volatility is no longer expanding as the Bollinger width contracts while price stays in the lower half of the envelope. Furthermore, a developing harmonic bat pattern with a bull orientation sits directly underneath price at 1.1390, creating latent counter-pressure that could stall the decline if buyers step in around these lows.

Monitoring the market next week requires watching whether this bearish shift can convert into durable expansion or simply dissolves back into the prevailing chop. For the downside move to prove sustainable, sellers need to see re-acceleration rise further while breaking decisively through the lower Bollinger boundary near 1.13458 without immediate bullish absorption. Conversely, any sustained rotation back above the 1.1455 broken pivot and the 1.14295 middle band would expose the recent downside extension as another temporary dip within an unresolved, highly transitional market structure.
